aggregation.fidelities: from the summed terms kept by hd_run (N, N2, M, Dsnr, Lsnr)
aggregation.tasks: pooled over the groups of a recording as in directive 018 (fm_reduce.task_scores)
aggregation.table3: on the frontier: medians over recordings per (s, k, QP); the best score whose median bits do not exceed the budget
aggregation.b_at_Fsnr: per recording, the first pair of consecutive QPs (QP order) that brackets the target, linear in Fsnr
